title: Are We Really Measuring Forgetting? Pitfalls in Evaluating Machine Unlearning for Multimodal LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.19613v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As machine unlearning for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) rapidly advances, rigorous evaluation of its effectiveness becomes increasingly important. However, existing benchmarks largely inherit evaluation protocols from text-only unlearning and overlook the unique challenges of unlearning in multimodal settings. In this work, we identify three major pitfalls that may lead to misleading conclusions: the lack of heldout evaluation to distinguish genuine concept-wise forgetting from instance-wise overfitting, the reliance on synthetic, fine-tuned knowledge rather than real-world knowledge acquired during pre-training, and unfair method comparisons caused by applying the same training settings to different unlearning methods. To address these challenges, we introduce GEMMU (Generalizable Evaluation for Multimodal Machine Unlearning), a benchmark built on real-world knowledge and a principled evaluation protocol. translated_title: 我们真的在测量遗忘吗？多模态大语言模型机器遗忘评估中的陷阱
translated_abstract: 随着多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的机器遗忘技术快速发展，对其有效性的严格评估变得日益重要。然而，现有的基准测试大多沿用了纯文本遗忘的评估协议，忽视了多模态环境下遗忘所面临的独特挑战。在本工作中，我们识别出三个可能导致误导性结论的主要陷阱：缺乏保留集评估，无法区分真正的概念级遗忘与实例级过拟合；依赖合成的、通过微调注入的知识，而非预训练期间获取的真实世界知识；以及对不同遗忘方法应用相同训练设置所导致的不公平方法比较。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了GEMMU（Generalizable Evaluation for Multimodal Machine Unlearning，多模态机器遗忘的泛化评估），这是一个基于真实世界知识和原则性评估协议构建的基准。通过重新评估代表性方法……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文指出了多模态大语言模型机器遗忘评估中存在的三大陷阱——缺乏保留集评估区分概念级遗忘与实例级过拟合、依赖合成知识而非预训练真实知识、以及不公平的方法比较——并据此提出了基于真实世界知识和原则性评估协议的GEMMU基准。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies three major pitfalls in evaluating machine unlearning for multimodal LLMs—lack of heldout evaluation, reliance on synthetic knowledge, and unfair method comparisons—and introduces GEMMU, a benchmark built on real-world knowledge with a principled evaluation protocol.
